description: A simple black line art drawing of a bicycle composed within a rectangle, focusing on recognizable components.

components: A large circular shape representing the front wheel
Two parallel vertical lines for the front forks
A larger circular shape representing the rear wheel
Two horizontal lines for the seat tube and seat post
An ellipse to represent the handlebars
A line connecting the front and rear wheels to indicate the frame

drawing_instructions.composition: The bicycle will be composed in a simple, rectangular shape with the main components (front wheel, rear wheel, frame, seat, handlebars) placed within this rectangle. The front wheel will be larger than the rear wheel to represent the difference in size between them. The handlebars and seat tube will be parallel to each other and positioned at the top of the rectangle. Brake levers will be indicated as small circles near the bottom of the image for clarity.
